title: My Backpack Keeps Sneezing!
description: Mila discovers a tiny dragon that sneezes bubbles and watches closely to find out how to help.

cover.alt: Mila beside a blue backpack with a tiny dragon and floating bubbles.

illustration.alt: Comic page: A wiggling backpack, A tiny visitor, Bubbles everywhere.

blocks.title: A wiggling backpack
lines: Mila was getting her things ready when she heard a strange rustle.
Her blue backpack wiggled on the rug.
“I didn’t pack anything that could jump,” she whispered, leaning closer.

blocks.title: A tiny visitor
lines: She carefully opened the zipper and found two bright eyes looking up at her.
A tiny green dragon peeked out of the bag.
Mila jumped back, then burst into giggles.

blocks.title: Bubbles everywhere
lines: The visitor scrunched up its nose and sneezed.
Bubbles floated into the room instead of fire.
Mila reached to catch one, but the dragon kept rubbing its nose.
Something was bothering it.

variants.prompt: What came out of the dragon’s nose?
variants.correctFeedback: Yes! Bubbles came out of its nose.
variants.retryFeedback: Look at what floated through the room after the sneeze.

variants.prompt: Which detail shows that something was bothering the dragon?

options.text: It rubbed its nose and kept sneezing

variants.correctFeedback: That’s right: it rubbed its nose and kept sneezing.
variants.retryFeedback: Look back at the last panel on this page and watch its nose.

illustration.alt: Comic page: A drink of water, The yellow clue.

blocks.title: A drink of water
lines: “Maybe you need a drink,” Mila said.
She brought a bowl of water and waited while the dragon drank.
It looked happy for a moment.
Then another sneeze sent a bubble sailing past her.

blocks.title: The yellow clue
lines: Mila sat still and watched closely.
A yellow feather poked out of the backpack’s front pocket.
Whenever the dragon leaned toward the bag, the soft tip brushed against its nose.

variants.prompt: What brushed against the dragon’s nose?
variants.correctFeedback: Yes! The yellow feather brushed its nose.
variants.retryFeedback: Look for the thing sticking out of the backpack pocket.

variants.prompt: Which clue connects the feather to the sneezes?

options.text: The feather touched its nose before a sneeze
The dragon fell asleep when it saw the feather

variants.correctFeedback: Exactly: a tickle from the feather came before a sneeze.
variants.retryFeedback: Think about what touched its nose just before it sneezed.

illustration.alt: Comic page: No more tickles, A peaceful new friend.

blocks.title: No more tickles
lines: “That feather is tickling you!”
Mila pulled it from the pocket and placed it in her craft cup across the room.
She waited a little longer.
This time, there was no sneeze.

blocks.title: A peaceful new friend
lines: The dragon snuggled into the open backpack and closed its eyes.
Mila smiled as the last bubble drifted toward the ceiling.
Her new friend could finally enjoy a peaceful rest.

variants.prompt: Where did Mila put the feather?

options.text: In a cup across the room

variants.correctFeedback: Yes! She put it in a cup, away from her friend.
variants.retryFeedback: Follow the yellow feather to the craft cup.

variants.prompt: What helped Mila find a solution?

options.text: Watching what touched the dragon’s nose
Giving the dragon more and more water

variants.correctFeedback: Exactly: watching closely helped her find the cause.
variants.retryFeedback: Remember what she noticed when she stopped watching the bubbles.

rustle.definition: A soft sound made when things move against each other.

carefully.definition: In a way that takes care to avoid a mistake.

bothering.definition: Making someone feel uncomfortable or upset.

snuggled.definition: Settled into a warm, comfortable spot.
